nary_nodes.label: Spain wins 2026 World Cup final
evidence: Spain beat Argentina to win World Cup
Spain triumphed in a battle of endurance, for players and spectators, to beat the Argentines and win their second men's World Cup.
nary_nodes.type_justification: SportsEvent accurately describes an event involving athletic competition, and a football match victory is the culmination of such an event.

nary_nodes.label: Ferran Torres scores extra-time winner
evidence: When Ferran Torres slammed in the extra-time winner, and Rodri lifted the trophy high in New Jersey, it is hard to imagine many will have had sympathy for Argentina.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Scoring a goal is an event that occurs within the context of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Rodri lifts World Cup trophy
evidence: When Ferran Torres slammed in the extra-time winner, and Rodri lifted the trophy high in New Jersey, it is hard to imagine many will have had sympathy for Argentina.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Lifting a trophy is an event closely associated with the conclusion and celebration of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Alan Shearer: Spain deserved win
evidence: "There is no doubt that the right team won," former England captain Alan Shearer said on BBC One.
"From start to finish, Spain controlled possession. They were the ones looking to play football, create chances and get in behind."
"This is a result for football because of the way that they have played. Spain deserve it."

nary_nodes.label: Unai Simon wins Golden Glove
evidence: At the other end, goalkeeper Unai Simon kept his seventh clean sheet in eight matches as he won the Golden Glove for the tournament's best goalkeeper.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Receiving a sports award is an event that typically occurs in the context of or immediately following a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Spain conceded fewest goals
evidence: Spain conceded just one goal at the 2026 World Cup - the fewest conceded by any winning team.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A team's performance, such as conceding the fewest goals, is a key aspect and outcome of a sports event or tournament, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Spain drew with Cape Verde
evidence: They stumbled out of the gates in this World Cup with a 0-0 draw against Cape Verde - meaning that on both occasions Spain have won the world title they have failed to win their opener, after a 1-0 loss to Switzerland in 2010.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A match draw is a specific outcome of a sports competition, which is encompassed by the SportsEvent type.

nary_nodes.label: Spain lost to Switzerland in 2010
evidence: They stumbled out of the gates in this World Cup with a 0-0 draw against Cape Verde - meaning that on both occasions Spain have won the world title they have failed to win their opener, after a 1-0 loss to Switzerland in 2010.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A match loss is a specific outcome of a sports competition, which is encompassed by the SportsEvent type.

nary_nodes.label: Rodri and Cubarsi complete 100+ passes
evidence: There have only been three instances on record of a player completing 100 or more passes in a World Cup final.
Two of those were Spain players on Sunday - Rodri with 101, and Pau Cubarsi with 121.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event describing an individual player's actions or statistics during a sports match or tournament.
nary_nodes.type_justification: No suitable schema.org class for an individual player's performance during a sports event. PlayerPerformance is a specific type of event occurring within a SportsEvent.

nary_nodes.label: Pau Cubarsi named young player
evidence: Cubarsi, 19, was named young player of the tournament, while it seems very likely his Barcelona team-mate Lamine Yamal has his best years ahead.
nary_nodes.type_justification: Receiving a sports award is an event that typically occurs in the context of or immediately following a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Lamine Yamal plays in World Cup final
evidence: At 19 years and six days, Lamine Yamal became the third-youngest player to play in a World Cup final, after Pele in 1958 and Giuseppe Bergomi in 1982.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player's debut in a competition is an event that occurs within the context of a sports event, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Lamine Yamal becomes third-youngest winner
evidence: He is now the third-youngest winner.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player's achievement is an event that occurs in the context of or as a result of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina had no shot in 90 minutes
evidence: At the other end, meanwhile, the defending champions became the first team in World Cup history not to have a shot in 90 minutes of a final.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A team's performance, such as having no shots on goal, is a key aspect and outcome of a sports event, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Lionel Messi makes first attempt
evidence: Their first attempt came via Lionel Messi in the 117th minute.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player's action, such as making an attempt, is an event that occurs within the context of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Argentina loses World Cup crown
evidence: Argentina lost their crown, and the scenes that followed the final whistle led many to feel they had lost their dignity too.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A team loss is a specific outcome of a sports competition, which is encompassed by the SportsEvent type.

nary_nodes.label: Enzo Fernandez receives yellow cards
evidence: Fernandez was first shown a yellow card for dissent, then a second for a spectacularly late challenge that sent Cubarsi somersaulting.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player receiving a penalty is an event that occurs within the context of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Paredes involved in scraps
evidence: After the full-time whistle, Paredes was involved in scraps with Rodri, Gavi and Borja Iglesias and team mate Nahuel Molina was seen throwing a punch at a passing Spain player too.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player altercation is an event that occurs within the context of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Nahuel Molina throws punch
evidence: After the full-time whistle, Paredes was involved in scraps with Rodri, Gavi and Borja Iglesias and team mate Nahuel Molina was seen throwing a punch at a passing Spain player too.
nary_nodes.type_justification: A player altercation is an event that occurs within the context of a sports competition, making SportsEvent the most appropriate general category.

nary_nodes.label: Wayne Rooney criticizes Argentina's behavior
evidence: "Embarrassing, seeing that sort of stuff after the game has been played," said BBC pundit Wayne Rooney.
"Someone has been crowned World Cup champions. It is not good enough."
"Paredes is better than that. It doesn't stop there. He keeps going and going."

nary_nodes.label: Lionel Scaloni defends team's performance
evidence: Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni attempted to defend his side's performance through floods of tears at his post-match media conference, but could only admit the best team had won.
nary_nodes.type_definition: An event where a sports manager makes a public declaration or comment, often regarding a team's performance or a match.

nary_nodes.label: Scaloni admits best team won
evidence: Argentina manager Lionel Scaloni attempted to defend his side's performance through floods of tears at his post-match media conference, but could only admit the best team had won.
"They deserved the victory, that is the reality."

nary_nodes.label: Scaloni questions outcome with 11 men
evidence: "Even though they were out-playing us until the 85th minute, I would love to know what would have happened had we still had 11 men on the pitch," he said of Fernandez's dismissal.

nary_nodes.label: Joe Hart: Argentina has no complaints
evidence: "Argentina can have absolutely no complaints about what happened," former England goalkeeper Joe Hart told BBC One.
"Disgusting behaviour."
"I don't think Rodri needed to get in their faces but you understand that after 120 minutes where you have been wound up and you thought you've been wronged, and the referee has been on your back."
